text: As I walk through these angled corridors, the modern glass walls and illuminated signs evoke a sense of curiosity mixed with dislocation. Entering the vibrant, information-dense R+D display, I feel inspired and alert—surrounded by the spirit of innovation and inquiry. My mind is both stimulated by the creative environment and humbled by the sheer amount of knowledge on display. I wonder what new perspectives I might gain if I linger here and engage deeply.
